note: Fixed textbook parameters, 11 pairs, $5 risk per trade per pair, costs counted, gapped stops at the open, swap NOT counted (matters most for the long-holding momentum rule), drawdown on closed trades only. 6 strategies tested at once, so a pass needs ALL checks, incl. a block-bootstrap luck test (<1%) and entering at the next open. Dollar figures are not equal-risk across strategies (stop widths differ); compare with pf and pass. A momentum pass would still need a carry/swap check. Paper research only.

mean_reversion_20d_2sd.doc:
price stretched 2 standard deviations from its 20-day average -> bet it comes back; exit at the average
    (plus our 2.5 ATR stop and 10-day limit)

momentum_12m_monthly.doc:
12-month time-series momentum on spot, checked once a month (managed-futures style). Differences from the
    academic version: no carry/swap, a 6 ATR disaster stop, and flat after a stop until the next month

turtle_55_20.doc: Turtle system 2: enter on a 55-day high/low, exit on a 20-day low/high

pullback_200_rsi2.doc:
Connors-style: above the 200-day average buy when RSI(2) < 10, below it sell when RSI(2) > 90; exit when the
    close crosses the 5-day average (plus our 2 ATR stop and 10-day limit)
